question_en: The HCF of two numbers is 11 and their LCM is 7700. If one of the numbers is 275, find the other number:

question_hi: सामान्य विज्ञान में, 'Insulin hormone secretion organ' का सही उत्तर क्या है?

question_hi: सामान्य विज्ञान में, 'Minimum distance between sound source and reflector for hearing echo' का सही उत्तर क्या है?

question_en: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29?
question_hi: किसी संख्या को 899 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 63 प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 29 से भाग दिया जाए, तो शेषफल क्या होगा?
explanation: Since 899 is divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the required remainder = 63 mod 29 = 5.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours and another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be full?
question_hi: एक नल किसी हौज को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है तथा दूसरा नल उसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो हौज कितने घंटे में भरेगा?
explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, time required = 36 hours.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A boat goes 15 km upstream and 21 km downstream taking 3 hours each time. What is the speed of the stream?
question_hi: एक नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 15 किमी तथा धारा के अनुकूल 21 किमी जाने में प्रत्येक बार 3 घंटे का समय लेती है। धारा की चाल क्या है?
explanation: Downstream speed = 21/3 = 7 km/h; Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Speed of stream = (7 - 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 km/h.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The average score of a batsman in 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he score in his next innings to raise his average by 4 runs?
question_hi: एक बल्लेबाज का 10 पारियों में औसत स्कोर 32 था। अगली पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि उसका औसत 4 रन बढ़ जाए?
explanation: New average = 32 + 4 = 36. Total runs after 11 innings = 11 × 36 = 396. Required score = 396 - (10 × 32) = 396 - 320 = 76 runs.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and its perimeter is 144 cm. The area of the triangle is:
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा इसका परिमाप 144 सेमी है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
explanation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 144 -> x = 12. Sides are 36, 48, 60 cm (right-angled triangle: 36² + 48² = 60²). Area = (1/2) × 36 × 48 = 864 cm².

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A train 180 metres long is running at a speed of 90 km/h. How long will it take to pass a bridge 320 metres long?
question_hi: 180 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। 320 मीटर लम्बे पुल को पार करने में इसे कितना समय लगेगा?
explanation: Speed = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total distance = 180 + 320 = 500 m. Time = 500 / 25 = 20 seconds.

source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours and another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be full? (Problem Set #3)
question_hi: एक नल किसी हौज को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है तथा दूसरा नल उसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो हौज कितने घंटे में भरेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #3)
explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, time required = 36 hours.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A boat goes 15 km upstream and 21 km downstream taking 3 hours each time. What is the speed of the stream? (Problem Set #3)
question_hi: एक नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 15 किमी तथा धारा के अनुकूल 21 किमी जाने में प्रत्येक बार 3 घंटे का समय लेती है। धारा की चाल क्या है? (प्रश्न सेट #3)
explanation: Downstream speed = 21/3 = 7 km/h; Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Speed of stream = (7 - 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 km/h.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The average score of a batsman in 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he score in his next innings to raise his average by 4 runs? (Problem Set #3)
question_hi: एक बल्लेबाज का 10 पारियों में औसत स्कोर 32 था। अगली पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि उसका औसत 4 रन बढ़ जाए? (प्रश्न सेट #3)
explanation: New average = 32 + 4 = 36. Total runs after 11 innings = 11 × 36 = 396. Required score = 396 - (10 × 32) = 396 - 320 = 76 runs.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and its perimeter is 144 cm. The area of the triangle is: (Problem Set #3)
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा इसका परिमाप 144 सेमी है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #3)
explanation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 144 -> x = 12. Sides are 36, 48, 60 cm (right-angled triangle: 36² + 48² = 60²). Area = (1/2) × 36 × 48 = 864 cm².

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A train 180 metres long is running at a speed of 90 km/h. How long will it take to pass a bridge 320 metres long? (Problem Set #3)
question_hi: 180 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। 320 मीटर लम्बे पुल को पार करने में इसे कितना समय लगेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #3)
explanation: Speed = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total distance = 180 + 320 = 500 m. Time = 500 / 25 = 20 seconds.

question_en: Find the unit digit in the product: (2467)^153 × (341)^72: (Problem Set #4)
explanation: Cyclicity of 7 is 4. 153 mod 4 = 1, so 7^1 = 7. Unit digit of (341)^72 is always 1. Product unit digit = 7 × 1 = 7.

question_en: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29? (Problem Set #4)

explanation: Since 899 is divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the required remainder = 63 mod 29 = 5.

question_en: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours and another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be full? (Problem Set #7)
question_hi: एक नल किसी हौज को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है तथा दूसरा नल उसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो हौज कितने घंटे में भरेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #7)
explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, time required = 36 hours.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A boat goes 15 km upstream and 21 km downstream taking 3 hours each time. What is the speed of the stream? (Problem Set #7)
question_hi: एक नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 15 किमी तथा धारा के अनुकूल 21 किमी जाने में प्रत्येक बार 3 घंटे का समय लेती है। धारा की चाल क्या है? (प्रश्न सेट #7)
explanation: Downstream speed = 21/3 = 7 km/h; Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Speed of stream = (7 - 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 km/h.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The average score of a batsman in 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he score in his next innings to raise his average by 4 runs? (Problem Set #7)
question_hi: एक बल्लेबाज का 10 पारियों में औसत स्कोर 32 था। अगली पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि उसका औसत 4 रन बढ़ जाए? (प्रश्न सेट #7)
explanation: New average = 32 + 4 = 36. Total runs after 11 innings = 11 × 36 = 396. Required score = 396 - (10 × 32) = 396 - 320 = 76 runs.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and its perimeter is 144 cm. The area of the triangle is: (Problem Set #7)
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा इसका परिमाप 144 सेमी है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #7)
explanation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 144 -> x = 12. Sides are 36, 48, 60 cm (right-angled triangle: 36² + 48² = 60²). Area = (1/2) × 36 × 48 = 864 cm².

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A train 180 metres long is running at a speed of 90 km/h. How long will it take to pass a bridge 320 metres long? (Problem Set #7)
question_hi: 180 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। 320 मीटर लम्बे पुल को पार करने में इसे कितना समय लगेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #7)
explanation: Speed = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total distance = 180 + 320 = 500 m. Time = 500 / 25 = 20 seconds.

question_en: Find the unit digit in the product: (2467)^153 × (341)^72: (Problem Set #8)
explanation: Cyclicity of 7 is 4. 153 mod 4 = 1, so 7^1 = 7. Unit digit of (341)^72 is always 1. Product unit digit = 7 × 1 = 7.

question_en: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29? (Problem Set #8)
question_hi: किसी संख्या को 899 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 63 प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 29 से भाग दिया जाए, तो शेषफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #8)
explanation: Since 899 is divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the required remainder = 63 mod 29 = 5.

question_en: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours and another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be full? (Problem Set #11)
question_hi: एक नल किसी हौज को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है तथा दूसरा नल उसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो हौज कितने घंटे में भरेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #11)
explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, time required = 36 hours.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A boat goes 15 km upstream and 21 km downstream taking 3 hours each time. What is the speed of the stream? (Problem Set #11)
question_hi: एक नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 15 किमी तथा धारा के अनुकूल 21 किमी जाने में प्रत्येक बार 3 घंटे का समय लेती है। धारा की चाल क्या है? (प्रश्न सेट #11)
explanation: Downstream speed = 21/3 = 7 km/h; Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Speed of stream = (7 - 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 km/h.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The average score of a batsman in 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he score in his next innings to raise his average by 4 runs? (Problem Set #11)
question_hi: एक बल्लेबाज का 10 पारियों में औसत स्कोर 32 था। अगली पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि उसका औसत 4 रन बढ़ जाए? (प्रश्न सेट #11)
explanation: New average = 32 + 4 = 36. Total runs after 11 innings = 11 × 36 = 396. Required score = 396 - (10 × 32) = 396 - 320 = 76 runs.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and its perimeter is 144 cm. The area of the triangle is: (Problem Set #11)
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा इसका परिमाप 144 सेमी है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #11)
explanation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 144 -> x = 12. Sides are 36, 48, 60 cm (right-angled triangle: 36² + 48² = 60²). Area = (1/2) × 36 × 48 = 864 cm².

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A train 180 metres long is running at a speed of 90 km/h. How long will it take to pass a bridge 320 metres long? (Problem Set #11)
question_hi: 180 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। 320 मीटर लम्बे पुल को पार करने में इसे कितना समय लगेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #11)
explanation: Speed = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total distance = 180 + 320 = 500 m. Time = 500 / 25 = 20 seconds.

question_en: Find the unit digit in the product: (2467)^153 × (341)^72: (Problem Set #12)
explanation: Cyclicity of 7 is 4. 153 mod 4 = 1, so 7^1 = 7. Unit digit of (341)^72 is always 1. Product unit digit = 7 × 1 = 7.

question_en: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29? (Problem Set #12)
question_hi: किसी संख्या को 899 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 63 प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 29 से भाग दिया जाए, तो शेषफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #12)
explanation: Since 899 is divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the required remainder = 63 mod 29 = 5.

subject: Quantitative Ability

question_en: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours and another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be full? (Problem Set #15)
question_hi: एक नल किसी हौज को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है तथा दूसरा नल उसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो हौज कितने घंटे में भरेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #15)
explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, time required = 36 hours.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A boat goes 15 km upstream and 21 km downstream taking 3 hours each time. What is the speed of the stream? (Problem Set #15)
question_hi: एक नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 15 किमी तथा धारा के अनुकूल 21 किमी जाने में प्रत्येक बार 3 घंटे का समय लेती है। धारा की चाल क्या है? (प्रश्न सेट #15)
explanation: Downstream speed = 21/3 = 7 km/h; Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Speed of stream = (7 - 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 km/h.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The average score of a batsman in 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he score in his next innings to raise his average by 4 runs? (Problem Set #15)
question_hi: एक बल्लेबाज का 10 पारियों में औसत स्कोर 32 था। अगली पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि उसका औसत 4 रन बढ़ जाए? (प्रश्न सेट #15)
explanation: New average = 32 + 4 = 36. Total runs after 11 innings = 11 × 36 = 396. Required score = 396 - (10 × 32) = 396 - 320 = 76 runs.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and its perimeter is 144 cm. The area of the triangle is: (Problem Set #15)
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा इसका परिमाप 144 सेमी है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #15)
explanation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 144 -> x = 12. Sides are 36, 48, 60 cm (right-angled triangle: 36² + 48² = 60²). Area = (1/2) × 36 × 48 = 864 cm².

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A train 180 metres long is running at a speed of 90 km/h. How long will it take to pass a bridge 320 metres long? (Problem Set #15)
question_hi: 180 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। 320 मीटर लम्बे पुल को पार करने में इसे कितना समय लगेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #15)
explanation: Speed = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total distance = 180 + 320 = 500 m. Time = 500 / 25 = 20 seconds.

question_en: Find the unit digit in the product: (2467)^153 × (341)^72: (Problem Set #16)
explanation: Cyclicity of 7 is 4. 153 mod 4 = 1, so 7^1 = 7. Unit digit of (341)^72 is always 1. Product unit digit = 7 × 1 = 7.

question_en: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29? (Problem Set #16)
question_hi: किसी संख्या को 899 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 63 प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 29 से भाग दिया जाए, तो शेषफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #16)
explanation: Since 899 is divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the required remainder = 63 mod 29 = 5.

question_en: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours and another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be full? (Problem Set #19)
question_hi: एक नल किसी हौज को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है तथा दूसरा नल उसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो हौज कितने घंटे में भरेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #19)
explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, time required = 36 hours.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A boat goes 15 km upstream and 21 km downstream taking 3 hours each time. What is the speed of the stream? (Problem Set #19)
question_hi: एक नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 15 किमी तथा धारा के अनुकूल 21 किमी जाने में प्रत्येक बार 3 घंटे का समय लेती है। धारा की चाल क्या है? (प्रश्न सेट #19)
explanation: Downstream speed = 21/3 = 7 km/h; Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Speed of stream = (7 - 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 km/h.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The average score of a batsman in 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he score in his next innings to raise his average by 4 runs? (Problem Set #19)
question_hi: एक बल्लेबाज का 10 पारियों में औसत स्कोर 32 था। अगली पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि उसका औसत 4 रन बढ़ जाए? (प्रश्न सेट #19)
explanation: New average = 32 + 4 = 36. Total runs after 11 innings = 11 × 36 = 396. Required score = 396 - (10 × 32) = 396 - 320 = 76 runs.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and its perimeter is 144 cm. The area of the triangle is: (Problem Set #19)
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा इसका परिमाप 144 सेमी है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #19)
explanation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 144 -> x = 12. Sides are 36, 48, 60 cm (right-angled triangle: 36² + 48² = 60²). Area = (1/2) × 36 × 48 = 864 cm².

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A train 180 metres long is running at a speed of 90 km/h. How long will it take to pass a bridge 320 metres long? (Problem Set #19)
question_hi: 180 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। 320 मीटर लम्बे पुल को पार करने में इसे कितना समय लगेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #19)
explanation: Speed = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total distance = 180 + 320 = 500 m. Time = 500 / 25 = 20 seconds.

question_en: Find the unit digit in the product: (2467)^153 × (341)^72: (Problem Set #20)
explanation: Cyclicity of 7 is 4. 153 mod 4 = 1, so 7^1 = 7. Unit digit of (341)^72 is always 1. Product unit digit = 7 × 1 = 7.

question_en: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29? (Problem Set #20)
question_hi: किसी संख्या को 899 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 63 प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 29 से भाग दिया जाए, तो शेषफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #20)
explanation: Since 899 is divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the required remainder = 63 mod 29 = 5.

question_en: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours and another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be full? (Problem Set #23)
question_hi: एक नल किसी हौज को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है तथा दूसरा नल उसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो हौज कितने घंटे में भरेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #23)
explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, time required = 36 hours.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: A boat goes 15 km upstream and 21 km downstream taking 3 hours each time. What is the speed of the stream? (Problem Set #23)
question_hi: एक नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 15 किमी तथा धारा के अनुकूल 21 किमी जाने में प्रत्येक बार 3 घंटे का समय लेती है। धारा की चाल क्या है? (प्रश्न सेट #23)
explanation: Downstream speed = 21/3 = 7 km/h; Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Speed of stream = (7 - 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 km/h.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The average score of a batsman in 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he score in his next innings to raise his average by 4 runs? (Problem Set #23)
question_hi: एक बल्लेबाज का 10 पारियों में औसत स्कोर 32 था। अगली पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि उसका औसत 4 रन बढ़ जाए? (प्रश्न सेट #23)
explanation: New average = 32 + 4 = 36. Total runs after 11 innings = 11 × 36 = 396. Required score = 396 - (10 × 32) = 396 - 320 = 76 runs.

subject: Quantitative Ability
source_paper: HSSC CET Expected Model Practice (NCERT / Math)
question_en: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and its perimeter is 144 cm. The area of the triangle is: (Problem Set #23)
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा इसका परिमाप 144 सेमी है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #23)
explanation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 144 -> x = 12. Sides are 36, 48, 60 cm (right-angled triangle: 36² + 48² = 60²). Area = (1/2) × 36 × 48 = 864 cm².

question_en: A train 180 metres long is running at a speed of 90 km/h. How long will it take to pass a bridge 320 metres long? (Problem Set #23)
question_hi: 180 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। 320 मीटर लम्बे पुल को पार करने में इसे कितना समय लगेगा? (प्रश्न सेट #23)
explanation: Speed = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total distance = 180 + 320 = 500 m. Time = 500 / 25 = 20 seconds.

question_en: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29? (Problem Set #24)
question_hi: किसी संख्या को 899 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 63 प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 29 से भाग दिया जाए, तो शेषफल क्या होगा? (प्रश्न सेट #24)
explanation: Since 899 is divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the required remainder = 63 mod 29 = 5.
